body: on this day in 2022: she walks out mid-set at HAIM's sold-out O2 Arena show — first time back on a concert stage in ages. "i heard that my girls were playing in london... and it looks like there's about 20,000 other people that also thought that, too." gasoline → love story, live, unannounced.
